definition: Mean over pixels of -6 times degree-eight normalized measured contrast polynomial at u plus isotropic forward-difference TV. Compare against attainable baseline energy under this same observation-defined objective.
polynomial_convention: Unique float64 least-squares projection of 19 normalized contrast values onto degree<=8 polynomials; normalized nodes k/9-1; intensity divided by255; contrast normalized per pixel by maximum plus0.3. Stable basis choice and solver trajectory are free.
reference_type: Attainable energy level, not physical depth truth
threshold_provenance: Declared per-pixel objective tolerance, validated with float32/float64 and alternate candidate controls; not noise calibration.
